message.content:
Based on the search results, I can clarify this for you.

New York, New York (meaning New York City) is **not in a single county**. Rather, New York City is a unique municipality that spans **five counties**, with each of its five boroughs being coextensive with a county:

| Borough | County |
|---------|--------|
| Manhattan | **New York County** |
| Brooklyn | Kings County |
| Queens | Queens County |
| The Bronx | Bronx County |
| Staten Island | Richmond County |

So when people say "New York, New York," they typically mean Manhattan, which is **New York County**. However, the city as a whole encompasses all five counties listed above.

This is confirmed by multiple sources stating that "Each borough is a county of New York State" and that "The borough of Manhattan shall consist of the territory known as New York county."

Sources:
1. https://guides.newman.baruch.cuny.edu/nyc_data
2. https://getworldmap.com/new-york-county-map/
3. https://ballotpedia.org/Counties_in_New_York
4. https://portal.311.nyc.gov/article/?kanumber=KA-02877
5. https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/newyorkcity/latest/NYCadmin/0-0-0-97
6. https://www.ny.gov/counties
